title: scurrula pentagonia

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating diseases.
